profile_text.body:
Pegasystems Inc is a public company headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts, traded under the ticker PEGA, with SEC CIK 0001013857. On its own site the company describes itself as a leading AI-powered platform for enterprise transformation, saying that large organizations use it to automate workflows, personalize customer experiences, and modernize legacy systems. It states that it has served the world's largest organizations since 1983.

The site presents Pega Platform as the core offering, with AI described as unified, predictable, and safe for mission-critical work, and governance built in. It also describes Pega Blueprint as an AI-powered workspace that brings business and IT together, and says its AI agents operate with context, compliance, and human oversight so that an agentic workforce can be orchestrated end to end. The company says its architecture is intended to support scale and continuous adaptation of enterprise processes and decisions.

The company's litigation exposure is recorded in Massachusetts, with 191 matters noted.
